startup_copies.name: end SRAM DATA from header literal 0x70

runtime_mapping_notes: startup_copies is the complete nonempty 32-bit scatter-copy set in startup helpers0x0c0c0224,0x0c0c028c,0x0c0c0314 and the entry loop0x0c0c003a. Ranges are half-open; file offsets are relative to vela_ap.bin, not the ZIP container.
The header literal at AP+0x70 covers only4 bytes at0x2019e724. It does not describe the earlier large SRAM/PSRAM startup copies.

To execute SRAM bodies in Unicorn, write main SRAM code bytes also at execute_alias0x00373e60. To resolve cached PSRAM globals and code callables, populate both destination0x3c000000 and execute_alias0x1c000000 from the same file bytes. Real hardware aliases share storage; a harness with independent Unicorn mappings must mirror mutable aliases when required.

Zero ranges are separate operations with no file-backed bytes. Do not attempt to read beyond the AP for BSS. Stack/vector installation and hardware initialization are not modeled by copying these ranges alone.
